title: A better welcome
description: Planning a friendly first visit to a fictional community garden.

segments.speaker: Robin
segments.text: A welcome guide could make first visits easier.

segments.speaker: Alex
segments.text: Agreed. Someone can take the first draft of the welcome guide.

segments.speaker: Robin
segments.text: It should cover where to find tools, how to water the seedlings, and who to ask for help. I'd also include a small map, because the shed is tucked behind the greenhouse. A few photos would help people recognize the right tools. We can leave the more detailed planting advice for another page, so this one feels welcoming and easy to skim.

segments.speaker: Alex
segments.text: We should have it ready soon, before the next group of visitors arrives.

segments.speaker: Robin
segments.text: A single page sounds right. Let's have it ready by Friday and try it with a few new visitors first.

segments.speaker: Alex
segments.text: We could either print the guide or put a small sign with a link by the gate.

segments.speaker: Robin
segments.text: Let's bring those options to the next garden meeting and hear what everyone thinks.
